title: Project Atlas Projects
description: Project data and preferences shared by Project Atlas integrations.

schemaVersion.description: Shared project data format version. The current version is 4.

id.description: Stable unique project identifier shared between IDEs. Keep existing identifiers unchanged.

path.description: Local project directory path. Use an absolute path.

tags.description: Tags used to group and filter the project.

favorite.description: Whether the project appears in Favorites.

lastOpenedAt.description: Last opened time as milliseconds since the Unix epoch, or null if never opened.

settings.description: Project view and opening preferences shared between IDEs.

enumDescriptions: Open projects in the current window.
Open projects in a new window.
defaultOpenMode.description: Default window used when opening a project.

enumDescriptions: Legacy value for sorting by most recently opened; treated as RECENT.
Legacy value that selects the Tags view.

selectedListFilter.description: Selected filter in the list view. Falls back to selectedFilter when omitted.

tagProjectSpacing.description: Project spacing preference for the Tags view. Rounded and clamped to 0–32 when read.

listProjectSpacing.description: Project spacing preference for the list view. Rounded and clamped to 0–32 when read.
